title: Game Off 2026
author: lee337reilly
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev! 👋

GitHub Game Off 2026 starts today!

It's a month-long game jam where you build a game inspired by a theme. This year's theme is **SHIFT**. Interpret it however you like.

Use AI, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, whatever. First game or fiftieth, everyone's welcome. Small experiments, ridiculous ideas, ambitious projects. All of it.

You've got until December 1. No prizes, no pressure. Just build something fun and share it!

Check it out: [https://github.blog/open-source/gaming/game-off-2026-the-theme-is-shift/](https://github.blog/open-source/gaming/game-off-2026-the-theme-is-shift/)

Share your shifty game ideas below 😆
